title: Google Sheets MCP Server | Awesome MCP Servers

facts.fact: The server's GitHub link on the directory page displays the number 105.
The MCP Google Sheets server requires Node.js version 22 or higher.
Setup requires a Google Cloud Project with the Sheets API enabled.
Setup requires a Google Cloud service account with a JSON key file.
facts.quote: Service Account with JSON key file

facts.fact: Each target spreadsheet must be shared with the service account email, granting it "Editor" permissions.
The page recommends using the mcp-gsheets@latest npm tag so the MCP client always runs the latest server version.
facts.quote: Using `mcp-gsheets@latest` ensures that your MCP client will always use the latest version of the MCP Google Sheets server.

facts.fact: When credentials are passed as the GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY JSON string, the entire JSON must be on a single line.
facts.quote: The entire JSON must be on a single line

facts.fact: If the service account JSON includes a project_id, the GOOGLE_PROJECT_ID variable can be omitted.
facts.quote: If the JSON includes a `project_id`, you can omit `GOOGLE_PROJECT_ID`

facts.fact: The server is designed to be run from MCP clients such as Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Cursor.
facts.quote: directly from your MCP client (e.g., Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, etc.)
